rationale: Generic resize-timing work in the Dawn GpuSurface and the Graphite SkiaSurface. resize() on both records the requested size and begin_frame() configures the swapchain and sizes the Graphite targets at most once per frame, so a live resize that delivers many size events per frame rebuilds them once; a zero dimension skips the frame. Pulp-owned host code delivers the processor's resize notification once per frame with the latest size, and Pulp-owned tests count configures and target allocations with a header-only SwapchainResizeState, on a real CAMetalLayer and through the macOS GPU plug-in host. Pulp continues to own these targets under the 2026-10-04 design-import refactor inheritance decision; Vellum inherits the render change when the targets adopt the Vellum package (change event 20261024-render-swapchain-lazy-configure). No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
